text: Even after a week of shorter waiting lines and newly opened hospital beds, a hospital lost power for one hour during unexpected maintenance.

rationales.valence: The passage balances improvements in waiting lines and bed availability against a brief power loss, with no explicit emotional appraisal.
rationales.arousal: The events are presented in restrained, matter-of-fact language; the unexpected interruption adds some tension but little intensity.
rationales.dominance: The narrator conveys neither agency nor helplessness.

ambiguities: The positive changes and negative interruption pull valence in different directions, so the overall tone is best read as balanced.
